purpose: Hash-pinned native Hiddify core assets used by the Haoze Connect build. The app/core source commits are recorded for provenance; native binaries are consumed only from the exact URLs and SHA256 digests below.

app.source: Upstream baseline preserved in the public YIYI-16/Haoze-Connect client branch.

core.note: hiddify-core draft native assets are newer than dependencies.properties core.version=4.1.0. The 4.1.0 stable AAR is incompatible with the app's main-branch PlatformInterface (missing NeighborUpdateListener/PlatformUser), so builds must use these pinned draft assets. Never auto-accept a changed draft digest: re-verify via the release API and update this file deliberately. The upstream draft was replaced on 2026-10-28. Build URLs now use a non-Latest first-party archive mirror; original SHA256 values, source URLs and upstream timestamps are preserved.
